item.title: Deregistration Under Section 8(f) of the Investment Company Act of 1940
item.description: Applicant seeks an order declaring that it has ceased to be an investment company. Applicant has never made a public offering of its securities and does not propose to make a public offering or engage in business of any kind. Filing Date: The application was filed on July 23, 2026, and amended on September 17, 2026. Applicant's Address: 1300 Godward Street Northeast, Suite 5500, Minneapolis, Minnesota 55413.
